name: Danish Quantum Community
description: The Danish Quantum Community (DQC) is a cross-sectoral organisation that unites quantum stakeholders in Denmark, spanning 70 partners from university research hubs, quantum startups, established companies, end-users, and investors. It organises events including an annual Scientific Quantum Conference and facilitates partnerships to strengthen Denmark's quantum research and technology development.
